items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 「你一定要照顾好自己。」中，"一定"的读音是？
items.explanation: 一 changes tone depending on what comes after it. In front of a fourth-tone syllable like 定 (dìng), 一 is said in the second tone, so 一定 is yídìng.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期一，练习4（printed p.32）

why.A: yīdìng keeps 一 in the first tone, which is how it sounds when you count — 一, 二, 三 — but not when it sits in front of a fourth-tone syllable.
why.B: yīdīng puts 定 in the first tone, but 定 is always a fourth tone, dìng, falling at the end of the word.
why.D: yìdīng has both tones the wrong way round: 一 is not a fourth tone here, and 定 is not a first tone.

items.prompt_en: How is 一定 pronounced in 「你一定要照顾好自己。」?
items.explanation_zh: "一"的声调会随后面的字变化：后面是第四声（定 dìng）时，"一"读第二声，所以"一定"读 yídìng。

why_zh.A: yīdìng 是"一"单独数数时的第一声（一、二、三），可是在第四声的字前面要变成第二声。
why_zh.B: yīdīng 把"定"读成了第一声，可"定"一直是第四声 dìng。
why_zh.D: yìdīng 两个声调都反了："一"在这里不读第四声，"定"也不读第一声。

items.subject: zh-char
items.explanation: 突 is built from 穴 on top and 犬 underneath. 穴 takes five strokes and 犬 takes four, so 突 has nine in all, and the radical is the part on top, 穴 — the textbook prints 穴 → 突 beside the character list.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期一，练习4（printed p.32）

why.B: 十；穴 picks the radical correctly but adds a stroke that is not there — 穴 is five strokes and 犬 is four, which comes to nine.
why.C: 九；犬 counts the strokes correctly, but 犬 is the part underneath; the radical of 突 is the 穴 above it.
why.D: 十；犬 misses twice over: the stroke count is nine, and the radical is 穴 rather than 犬.

items.prompt_en: How many strokes does 突 have, and what is its radical?
items.explanation_zh: "突"上面是"穴"，下面是"犬"。"穴"五画，"犬"四画，一共九画；部首是上面的"穴"——课本第50页写着"穴→突"。

why_zh.B: 十；穴 部首对了，但多数了一画："穴"五画加"犬"四画是九画。
why_zh.C: 九；犬 笔画数对了，可"犬"在下面，"突"的部首是上面的"穴"。
why_zh.D: 十；犬 两处都不对：九画，部首是"穴"。

items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 找不同，写出正确答案：一群______子在捞月亮。
items.explanation: 猴 (hóu), with 犭 on the left, is the monkey: 猴子. A group of monkeys is scooping at the moon.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第六课《猴子捞月亮》 星期四，练习1（printed p.37）

why.A: 候 (hòu) has 亻 and a short upright stroke, not the animal radical; it is the 候 of 时候, the time.
why.B: 劳 (láo) is the 劳 of 劳动, work, with 艹 on top; nothing about it is an animal.
why.D: 捞 is the scooping word that belongs in the other blank, 在捞月亮; 捞子 is not a word.

items.prompt_en: Find the difference: which character fills the blank? 一群______子在捞月亮。
items.explanation_zh: "猴"是反犬旁，说的是动物：猴子。一群猴子在捞月亮。

why_zh.A: "候"是单人旁加一小竖，不是反犬旁；它是"时候"的"候"。
why_zh.B: "劳"是"劳动"的"劳"，上面是草字头，和动物没有关系。
why_zh.D: "捞"是另一个空的字（在捞月亮），"捞子"不是词。

items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 找不同，写出正确答案：一群猴子在______月亮。
items.explanation: 捞 (lāo) has 扌, the hand: taking something out of water is done by hand. 在捞月亮: they are scooping at the moon.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第六课《猴子捞月亮》 星期四，练习1（printed p.37）

why.B: 猴 is the monkey of the other blank, an animal and not an action.
why.C: 候 is the 候 of 时候, the time; it is not something you can do to the moon.
why.D: 劳 (láo) looks like 捞 without the hand and sounds close to it, but it means work, as in 劳动; to scoop you need the hand, 扌.

items.prompt_en: Find the difference: which character fills the blank? 一群猴子在______月亮。
items.explanation_zh: "捞"是提手旁，从水里拿东西要用手：在捞月亮。

why_zh.B: "猴"是另一个空的字，是动物，不是动作。
why_zh.C: "候"是"时候"的"候"，不是能对月亮做的动作。
why_zh.D: "劳"和"捞"只差一个提手旁，读音也像，可它是"劳动"的"劳"；捞东西要用手，所以要有扌。

items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 找不同，写出正确答案：我有一______可爱的小狗，它总爱跟着我。
items.explanation: 只 (zhī) is the measure word for animals: 一只小狗, just as the text says 一只小猴子.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第六课《猴子捞月亮》 星期四，练习1（printed p.37）

why.A: 直 (zhí) sounds almost the same, but it means straight, as in 一直; it does not count dogs.
why.C: 跟 means follow, the word of the other blank (跟着我); it cannot count a dog.
why.D: 根 counts long thin things, like 一根筷子, and a puppy is not long and thin.

items.prompt_en: Find the difference: which character fills the blank? 我有一______可爱的小狗，它总爱跟着我。
items.explanation_zh: "只"是量词，数小动物用：一只小狗，课文里也说"一只小猴子"。

why_zh.A: "直"读音很像，可它是"一直"的"直"，意思是不弯，不能数小狗。
why_zh.C: "跟"是"跟着"的"跟"，是另一个空的字，不能数小狗。
why_zh.D: "根"数细长的东西，像"一根筷子"，小狗不是细长的东西。

items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 找不同，写出正确答案：我有一只可爱的小狗，它总爱______着我。
items.explanation: 跟 (gēn) has the foot radical: following someone is done on foot. 它总爱跟着我: it always likes to follow me.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第六课《猴子捞月亮》 星期四，练习1（printed p.37）

why.A: 根 (gēn) sounds the same and shares 艮, but it has 木, the tree: 树根, a root. A root cannot follow anyone.
why.B: 直 means straight, as in 一直; 直着我 says nothing.
why.C: 只 is the measure word of the other blank, 一只小狗; 只着我 says nothing.

items.prompt_en: Find the difference: which character fills the blank? 我有一只可爱的小狗，它总爱______着我。
items.explanation_zh: "跟"是足字旁，跟着别人走要用脚：它总爱跟着我。

why_zh.A: "根"读音一样，右边也是"艮"，可它是木字旁，是"树根"的"根"，不会跟着人走。
why_zh.B: "直"是"一直"的"直"，"直着我"说不通。
why_zh.C: "只"是另一个空的量词（一只小狗），"只着我"说不通。

items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 找不同，写出正确答案：爸爸来学校______我，回家的路上，我们碰见了哥哥。
items.explanation: 接 (jiē) is going to meet someone and bring them back: 爸爸来学校接我, Dad comes to school to pick me up.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第六课《猴子捞月亮》 星期四，练习1（printed p.37）

why.A: 提 (tí) also has 扌, but it means lifting something by a handle, as in 提水; a child is collected with 接.
why.C: 碰 belongs in the other blank, 碰见了哥哥; 碰我 would be bumping into me, not collecting me.
why.D: 朋 is the 朋 of 朋友, a friend, and not something Dad can do.

items.prompt_en: Find the difference: which character fills the blank? 爸爸来学校______我，回家的路上，我们碰见了哥哥。
items.explanation_zh: "接"是去把人带回来：爸爸来学校接我。

why_zh.A: "提"也是提手旁，可它是"提水"的"提"，把东西拎起来；来学校带孩子回家用"接"。
why_zh.C: "碰"是另一个空的字（碰见了哥哥）；"碰我"是撞到我，不是来接我。
why_zh.D: "朋"是"朋友"的"朋"，不是爸爸能做的事。

items.subject: zh-char
items.prompt: 找不同，写出正确答案：爸爸来学校接我，回家的路上，我们______见了哥哥。
items.explanation: 碰见 is meeting someone by chance. On the way home they happened to run into big brother: 我们碰见了哥哥.
items.source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第六课《猴子捞月亮》 星期四，练习1（printed p.37）

why.A: 朋 (péng) sounds almost like 碰 (pèng), but it is the 朋 of 朋友, and 朋见 is not a word.
why.B: 提 is lifting something by a handle, as in 提水, and 提见 is not a word.
why.D: 接 is Dad's word from the other blank. 接见 is a real word, but it is an important person formally receiving visitors, not bumping into your brother on the way home.

items.prompt_en: Find the difference: which character fills the blank? 爸爸来学校接我，回家的路上，我们______见了哥哥。
items.explanation_zh: "碰见"是没约好，在路上遇到：我们碰见了哥哥。

why_zh.A: "朋"和"碰"读音很像，可它是"朋友"的"朋"，"朋见"不是词。
why_zh.D: "接"是另一个空的字。"接见"虽然是个词，可它是大人物正式见客人，不是在路上遇到哥哥。
